title: Startup Careers Coach
description:
Leland is building the home for ambition in the age of AI. We connect people with the experts, programs, and communities they need to land the job, get into the school, or upskill for a world being rewritten by AI. We help businesses become AI-native through training, hiring, and infrastructure. Since our founding in 2021, we've helped tens of thousands of people reach their most ambitious goals and raised $19M from world-class investors. Ambition is sacred to us, and we've built a product that takes that seriously.
We're seeking an experienced startup careers coach to work with students and professionals pursuing careers at startups. This role includes helping candidates apply AI fundamentals and AI automation to their work, as well as conducting competitive analysis to evaluate potential companies and opportunities. Coaches also support the full career journey, including resume review, cover letters, LinkedIn review, interview prep, and networking strategy to help candidates land the right role at a startup. Ideal candidates have professional experience working at or advising startups, prior coaching or mentoring experience, and a clear, structured approach to helping candidates navigate the fast-paced startup hiring landscape. Coaches set their own hours and rates, host sessions virtually, and partner with our team to deliver a high-quality, supportive experience for every student.
Why Leland ?

• The chance to join a world-class team helping people achieve their career and educational dreams

• Work in a collaborative, high-energy environment where your contributions have a direct impact

• Operate in a fast-paced, AI-native environment

• We don't hire people who merely want to work for a great company; we hire people who want to make a great company

Leland is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds and demographics to apply.

title: Open Source Contributor (GitHub)
description:
Pay: $100-$150/hour
Location: Global, fully remote
Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)
Schedule: Flexible-you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if needed
We are looking for highly skilled Open-Source Software Engineers to contribute to an AI training project involving software development, repository exploration, debugging, system architecture, and code evaluation.
The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging software-engineering tasks across front-end and back-end systems and helping with translating full coding builds from one particular language into another.
We are particularly interested in engineers who own or maintain open-source repositories or have made meaningful contributions to established projects. Contributions should demonstrate real engineering ability, not only documentation updates, dependency bumps, formatting changes, or minor typo corrections.
Candidates should be prepared to discuss specific repositories, pull requests, issues, and code they personally authored.
What You’ll Work On

• Explore and understand unfamiliar software repositories.

• Implement, modify, and debug front-end and back-end components.

• Trace data and execution across interfaces, services, libraries, APIs, databases, and external dependencies.

• Reproduce software issues and identify their underlying causes.

• Implement solutions that fit an existing project’s architecture and contribution standards.

• Write unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end tests.

• Review AI-generated patches for correctness, completeness, security, and maintainability.

Required Qualifications

• A public or otherwise verifiable GitHub profile .

• Meaningful ownership of or contributions to one or more open-source repositories.

• Strong software-engineering experience across front-end, back-end, full-stack, systems, developer tooling, infrastructure, or another substantial technical area.

• Experience with multiple programming languages.

• Ability to understand and modify unfamiliar codebases.

Relevant languages may include TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, Rust, C++, C#, Ruby, PHP , or other languages used in substantial open-source projects.
Process

• Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

• Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

• Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure
Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.
Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum number of tasks per week.
Start Timeline & Availability
We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first tasks within 24-48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: CCWP - Interim Managing Director

California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP)
Housed at Koreatown Immigrant Workers Alliance (KIWA)

The California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP) is a statewide table of worker centers, labor policy advocates, and unions advancing strategies that build durable worker power across California. Our coalition focuses on structural reforms that strengthen worker organizations, expand collective voice, and protect workers, including immigrant and Black workers, from retaliation and exploitation.California Coalition for Worker Power seeks an Interim Managing Director who understands coalition dynamics, coalition tables, operational systems and finances and can work collaboratively with CCWP leadership team, staff, and partners.
Overview

• Position Type: At-will, temporary, exempt

• Location: Remote, must be California-based

• Duration: 6-18 months

• Reports To: KIWA’s Executive Director, Coalition Co-Presidents and Co-Managing Directors

Position Summary
California Coalition for Worker Power seeks an experienced and hands-on Interim Managing Director to provide financial leadership and operational support during a short-term transition period. The Interim Managing Director will set up systems and oversee the organization’s financial operations, strengthen organizational digital security protocols, partner with the leadership team to fundraise strategy, and provide oversight of organizational activities, priorities, projects and decisions.

• Oversee the completion of the coalition’s financial systems, including identifying gaps and implementing practical systems to improve financial visibility, accountability, compliance and decision-making.

• Support the development and implementation of organizational security protocols.

• Lead the day-to-day operations of the coalition; ensure that decision-making structures, roles, responsibilities, and processes are clear, effective, and aligned with the coalition's long term agenda and goals.

• Ensure continuity between coalition meetings and decision-making spaces, communicate decisions, next steps, ownership, and timelines so that collective work moves forward between convenings, and retreats.

• Serve as strategic thought

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

More than that, we believe you will thrive by taking ownership of:

- Contributing the IT risk assessment and translating it into a prioritized testing plan across access, change management, and operations

- Implementing AI-driven and automated solutions to reduce manual testing effort and improve testing coverage

WHAT YOU BRING

- 3+ years of experience in IT audit, ITGC testing, or a related IT risk/compliance function

- Big 4 or co-source firm experience in IT audit

title: Principal Engineer - Game Innovation
description:
What are we building?
Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. Backed by a brand known the world over for gaming, entertainment, and hospitality, we operate like a fast-moving startup with a passion for building products millions of people play.
Our Games Studio is building the next generation of in-house casino content, and we are changing how that content gets made. We are building an AI-assisted development pipeline to design, build, and ship real-money games faster, and using it to go after formats the floor is not saturated with: Crash, Plinko, Mines, arcade-style games, skill-adjacent experiences, and formats that have not been invented yet. Two things at once: a new method for making all our games, and new kinds of games to make with it.
What's the position?
We are looking for a Principal Engineer, Game Innovation to be the technical lead for this effort. You will design and stand up the AI-assisted game development pipeline, own the architecture that takes a game from concept to a certified title live on our RGS, and build games on it yourself. You will pair with the Senior Producer, Game Innovation, who owns the product and the roadmap, while you own the technology and the build.
This is a hands-on principal role, not a management track. You will write code, make the architectural calls, and set the engineering standard for how AI-built games get produced and shipped in a regulated environment. The first question, can AI build a game, is already answered by working prototypes. The harder question is whether we can build a real framework that produces games we would put in front of real players for real money. That is your problem to solve.
Key Responsibilities

• Own the pipeline. Design and build the AI-assisted game development pipeline: a shared project with version control and CI/CD, agents that produce math, art, sound, and animation from a structured brief, automated evaluation gates, and a playable build the team can open from a link. Make it repeatable, so the second game is faster than the first.

• Own the architecture, front end to back end. Set the architecture for the game client and the back-end game server, including the round lifecycle, bet validation, outcome mapping against a certified RNG, wallet operations, reconciliation, RTP reporting, and the audit trail. Keep the math and the money server side.

• Integrate with our RGS. Lead the integration to Fingenuity, our RGS and RNG, and own the path that turns a candidate build into a certifiable, shippable title across jurisdictions.

• Build games, not just infrastructure. Stay hands-on. Prototype mechanics, build game clients and servers, and prove the pipeline by shipping real titles through it.

• Set the AI engineering standard. Define how we use AI-assisted tools and agents in game development: the conventions, the guardrails, the human review gates, and the automated checks that verify AI output before it advances. Nothing AI-generated ships uninspected.

• Choose the stack. Make the build, buy, and partner calls on engine, tooling, and infrastructure, and standardize the studio on choices that are strong for AI-assisted development and support the client and server model.

• Partner across the business. Work with platform engineering, compliance, and our RGS and third-party partners. Bring the studio's math, art, and production talent along, and keep the bar high on quality and speed.

• Raise the bar around you. Mentor engineers who join this effort, establish the code review culture, and document the patterns so the pipeline outlives any one person.

Requirements
What are we looking for?
We are looking for a builder at principal level who wants to invent the way games get made, not maintain someone else's system. Someone who has shipped real-money games, understands what certification actually demands, and is genuinely excited about what AI does to the economics

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.
Apprenticeship Requirements:
This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work
Apprenticeship Program Learnings:
Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.
How to Apply:
The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

As a Technical Product Manager at BRIGHTSCOUT , you'll decide what gets built and why, then make sure it actually ships. On accounts where the client has their own product team, you'll partner with them to translate their vision into a backlog our engineering and design teams can execute against. On accounts where they don't, you'll be that product team: setting direction, making the calls a client's own PM would make, and representing their business goals inside every planning conversation.

This is a hybrid role by design. Some weeks you're closer to a Product Manager, working the vision, roadmap, and stakeholder tradeoffs. Other weeks you're closer to a Product Owner, writing acceptance criteria and keeping a sprint on track. You'll move fluidly between the two, and know which one a given moment calls for.

Responsibilities

• Product Vision, Client Partnership & Backlog Ownership

• Act as the acting product lead for clients without an in-house PM, building a working command of their business, users, and market deep enough to make credible calls on their behalf.

• Translate ambiguous business goals and stakeholder input into a clear product vision, roadmap, and prioritized, sequenced backlog - grooming it by user value, dependency, risk, and effort.

• Work alongside our Project Management team on scope, risk, and budget: you own what gets built, they own the plan and the day-to-day client cadence, and the two of you keep each other honest. Coordinate with the shared Capabilities team to keep priorities aligned across concurrent engagements.

• 5+ years of experience spanning product management and product ownership, ideally including agency, consultancy, or client-services work - comfortable owning both ends of the job, from setting direction with a client to writing a precise acceptance criterion.

• Enough technical fluency to hold a real conversation with engineers about architecture tradeoffs, APIs, and technical debt, without needing to write the code yourself.

• Analytically minded and hypothesis-driven, comfortable making calls with incomplete information, with a genuine sense of ownership over outcomes, not just outputs.

• Strong written and verbal communication, able to translate technical constraints

You will measure everything, incorporate AI, and drive real results that time to revenue impact. You are the connective tissue between Product, Product Marketing, Sales leadership, SA leadership, and the field.

This is a Principal-level individual contributor role. You lead through influence, the systems you build, and the credibility you earn.

- Extend enablement to adjacent technical roles as needed: Account Executives on technical fundamentals, Support on the sales motion, and partners on positioning.

DIAGNOSE, THEN PRESCRIBE

- Start from signals, not requests. Use call recordings, CRM data, win/loss, POC outcomes, certification results, and conversations with SA leaders to find the skill gaps that actually cost us deals, then classify and prioritize them with data.

- Pick the right modality for the gap: hands-on lab, self-serve path, live workshop, AI role-play, peer teaching, or in-the-moment coaching. Measure behavior change and deal outcomes.

- Close the loop. Systematically capture what is breaking in the field (friction, lost deals, recurring objections) and route it to Product, PMM, and Sales leadership as actionable recommendations.

BUILD AT SCALE

dein profil

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, against the challenging problems our customers face. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the existing workflows are, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.

- Meet with strategic customers to deeply understand their AI transformation goals and locate their biggest pain points, particularly around customer-facing and operational workflows powered by AI agents.

- Embed yourself deeply inside strategic customers: act as a trusted partner with a provisioned account, spend meaningful time onsite, and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.

As our federal portfolio grows, JCTM is strengthening its pricing capability to bring competitive pricing analysis earlier into capture, improve proposal economics, protect execution feasibility, and give leadership better information for pursuit and investment decisions.

title: Product Manager (LATAM)
description:
We're hiring a Product Manager for to join a globally distributed product and engineering team. The job is to turn business priorities into work engineers can pick up and ship, then stay with it through release.
This is hands on and execution first. You break the features them into requirements, sequenced plans and tickets that hold up under pressure. Day to day you're working with engineers, QA and business stakeholders, keeping projects moving and expectations honest.
There's room to grow. The product practice is still being built out, so discovery, PRDs, retrospectives and data informed prioritization are all things you'll be exposed to and can grow into over time.
Your first 6 months

• You own a portfolio of live projects end to end, from requirements through release, and everyone always knows where each one stands.

• Messy, multi part initiatives arrive from marketing, ops and customer experience, and you turn them into plans people can execute against.

• Your specs and acceptance criteria cut rework, with QA looped in early instead of at the end.

• You know the e-commerce stack, subscription flows and customer journeys well enough that engineers and stakeholders come to you first.

• You're contributing to sprint process, retros and planning cadence as the practice matures.

Who we're looking for

• 2-4 years in product management or technical project management. E-commerce or consumer products is a plus.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You write clear tickets, requirements and status updates, and you keep a distributed team aligned without endless back and forth.

• You chase ambiguity down rather than waiting on it, and you flag risk before it turns into a delay.

• Comfortable in Jira and Figma, at home with analytics tools. Shopify or other subscription commerce platforms a plus.

• Someone the team wants to work with. Much of this job is sitting between engineers and stakeholders, so being easy to collaborate with matters as much as process skill.

• Keen to grow as a PM, with mentorship and increasing ownership over time.

Engagement
Full time, remote, long term contract. Candidates based in South America with substantial overlap with US business hours.

title: Senior Project Manager - Cloud
description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery & Governance

• Plan and coordinate all aspects of AIC projects (strategy/assessments, architecture/design, implementation/execution, and transition to operations) from initiation through closure.

• Ensure service delivery success, quality, and customer satisfaction through effective project and program management practices.

• Lead project initiation activities, including confirmation of client objectives, success metrics, scope, assumptions, constraints, dependencies, and governance model .

• Develop, maintain, and execute project plans, schedules, budgets, work breakdown structures, and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs .

• Own project administration in AHEAD ’s tools (e.g., PSA), ensuring accurate project setup, resource plans, budgets, billing milestones, and status updates.

• Apply change control and Project Change Request (PCR) processes for scope, schedule, and budget changes in collaboration with ELs, TLs, and Sales.
2. Stakeholder & Client Management

• Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned projects, driving clear and proactive communication with client stakeholders and internal leadership.

• Facilitate status meetings, steering committees, and executive-level updates , providing transparent views of progress, risks, decisions, and financial health.

• Align delivery with AIC and client standards (e.g., Agile, hybrid, or waterfall delivery), ensuring the ways-of-working are explicit and followed.

• Partner with Engagement Leads and Client Directors to shape a top-notch client experience , including responsiveness, expectation management, and structured escalation handling.
3. Coordination of Global & After-Hours Work

• Oversee and coordinate after-hours and weekend change windows (e.g., production cutovers, platform migrations, major releases) in partnership with US-based PMs and TLs.

• Act as the primary offshore liaison during change events when assigned, ensuring alignment with approved implementation plans, backout plans, and validation steps.

• Maintain continuous communication channels across time zones (India ↔ U.S.) so that risks, blockers, and status are clearly handed off and tracked.

• When no after-hours activities are scheduled, work aligned to India/U.S. overlap hours to independently lead small to medium AIC projects (e.g., cloud adoption pilots, data platform workstreams, application modernization sprints).
4. Risk, Quality, and Financial Management

• Identify, document, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies , driving timely mitigation and escalation as needed.

• Ensure appropriate quality gates are defined and met (e.g., design reviews, test readiness, go/no-go, post-implementation reviews).

• Track and manage project budgets, burn rates, and margin , raising concerns early and partnering with ELs and practice leadership to protect both client value and profitability .

• Support PSA data hygiene by maintaining accurate time entry expectations, project end dates, budget adjustments, and revenue alignment.
5. Practice & PMO Enablement

• Model and reinforce AIC PMO standards for project hygiene, governance, and reporting, including use of standard templates, dashboards, and inspection routines.

• Contribute to practice development , including harvesting reusable artifacts (plans, RAID logs, status report templates, change playbooks) and improving delivery frameworks.

• Provide coaching and mentoring to junior project managers, coordinators, and consultants who are performing PM tasks on AIC engagements.

• Collaborate with Resource Management and Delivery leaders regarding resource planning and capacity management , helping to structure onshore/offshore staffing models that align to AIC scoping guidelines.
6. Pre-Sales & Opportunity Support (As Needed)

• Identify follow-on opportunities and work with client-facing teams to position next-phase work informed by project outcomes and client feedback.

title: Senior Director, Head of Analytical Development
description:
Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Director to lead Analytical Development across our small molecule and oligonucleotide portfolios. You will set the scientific direction, build the team, and ensure our methods, specifications, stability programs, and control strategies are ready for each stage of development, from pre-IND work through potential NDA/MAA approval.
This is a hands-on leadership role in a growing, agile organization. You will make consequential technical decisions, work closely with colleagues across Development CMC, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Clinical Supply, and hold external partners to a high standard. Your work will help move promising molecules toward medicines for patients.
Primary Responsibilities

•
Set the analytical strategy. Define and execute an approach for drug substance and drug product across the small molecule and oligonucleotide portfolios. Make clear choices about what each program needs now and what it will need at the next clinical or regulatory milestone.

•
Build reliable methods and controls. Lead analytical method development, qualification, validation, transfer, and lifecycle management. Establish specifications, comparability approaches, and control strategies with Process Development, Quality, and Regulatory Affairs.

•
Deliver regulatory-ready science. Author and review analytical CMC content for IND, IMPD/CTA, and NDA/MAA submissions. Represent Analytical Development in health authority interactions and explain the science clearly under scrutiny.

•
Lead external execution. Oversee CDMOs, CROs, and contract testing laboratories, including method transfers, stability programs, and investigations of out-of-specification or out-of-trend results. Surface risks early and drive them to resolution.

•
Build the function. Hire, coach, and develop a strong analytical team. Shape its structure and capabilities as the portfolio grows, while giving people clear ownership and direct, useful feedback.

•
Connect the work to program decisions. Partner with Process Development, Formulation Development, Clinical Supply, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and program teams so analytical deliverables support sound decisions and meet program timelines. Lead CMC teams and represent CMC function on cross functional program teams.

•
Raise the standard. Champion data integrity, GMP compliance, and continuous improvement. Stay current with analytical technologies and regulatory expectations, and apply new approaches when they will improve the work.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

• A Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Organic Chemistry, or a related field and 15+ years of relevant pharmaceutical or biotech experience; or an M.S./B.S. with commensurately greater experience.

• Deep experience developing and validating analytical methods and establishing control strategies for drug substance and drug product, from early development through late-stage or commercial readiness.

• Direct small molecule analytical development experience. Experience with ASO, siRNA, or other nucleic acid therapeutic analytics is strongly preferred.

• A record of authoring and defending analytical CMC content in regulatory filings and participating in health authority interactions.

• Experience directing CDMO/CRO relationships and outsourced analytical testing, with the judgment to identify issues and resolve them.

• People leadership experience and the ability to build a technical team in a growing organization.

• Strong working knowledge of ICH guidelines, USP/EP/JP compendial requirements, and current GMP regulations.

• Clear communication and sound judgment across scientific, operational, and executive discussions. Experience in CNS or rare disease development is a plus.

title: Robotics Deployment Project Manager
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

ROLE SCOPE

- Run the projects that put robotics into live sites and the factory: pilots, installs, and scale-up.

- Coordinate robot vendors, integrators, and site teams from first survey to steady-state operation.

- Own the deployment playbook: safety, commissioning, training, and support, so site two is easier than site one.

- Track performance after go-live and force the fix-or-pull decision on underperforming cells.

- Travel: ability to travel up to 25%-40% to our Labs and Data Centers

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

- You've deployed robotics, automation cells, or heavy equipment into operating environments.

- You've managed integrator and vendor scopes to acceptance criteria you wrote.

- You take safety reviews seriously enough to stop a job over one.

- You've turned a pilot into a repeatable rollout kit.

- You measure post-deployment reality, uptime and throughput, and act on it.

- Bonus: Industrial robotics platforms. Data center or manufacturing environments. Functional safety basics. Field commissioning.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

title: Inpatient Coder (CCS / CIC)
description:
Role Title: Inpatient Coder (ICD-10 / CCS / CIC)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Inpatient Coders (ICD-10 / CCS / CIC certified) to contribute their expertise to a dynamic project for a valued customer. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Annotate and review inpatient medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, operative reports, consults, lab and imaging results, and discharge summaries, ensuring precise ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS code assignment based on documentation.

• Identify principal and secondary diagnoses, sequence codes according to guidelines, assign Present on Admission (POA) indicators, and validate MS-DRG assignment, including the identification of CCs and MCCs, to verify and enrich data sets.

• Apply inpatient-specific coding conventions, such as UHDDS definitions, ICD-10-CM/PCS Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, and AHA Coding Clinic guidance, while identifying hospital-acquired conditions (HACs) and patient safety indicators.

• Collaborate with project stakeholders using both written and verbal communication to clarify requirements, resolve documentation ambiguities, and ensure data integrity.

• Deliver high-quality feedback on coding guidelines and complex cases to support project workflow improvements and enhance AI model understanding.

• Ensure accuracy and completeness of all coding-related annotations per current best practices and coding standards.

Preferred Qualifications

• Active AHIMA Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) or AAPC Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC) credential.

• Thorough expertise in ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, and MS-DRG methodology with hands-on inpatient coding experience.

• Experience coding in diverse inpatient settings, such as acute care, teaching hospitals, specialty units, surgical, trauma, oncology, cardiology, and transplant cases.

• Proficiency in reviewing and coding various types of clinical documentation and addressing complex coding challenges.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating meticulous attention to detail and clarity.

• Access to current ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS code sets, Official Coding Guidelines, and MS-DRG grouper tools.

Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Client Engineering is the technical arm of Plaid’s European GTM team. We own our customers’ technical outcomes: designing the right solution, getting it built and live, and keeping it healthy as they grow. We work with the most technically forward companies in European financial services - fintechs, lenders, and payments and wealth platforms - helping them build on payment initiation, account data, verification, and underwriting across UK Open Banking and PSD2.

As an Implementation Engineer for Plaid Europe, you’ll own customer integrations from the moment a contract is signed to the moment they’re live in production and growing. You’ll do the same for existing customers adding a new product, use case, or market. - Debug integration issues hands-on with customer engineers across API, SDK, OAuth redirect, and webhook behaviour.

- Validate sandbox implementations and run go-live readiness checks.

- Use Plaid’s own data to proactively diagnose integration and conversion problems.

- Produce written handovers to Account Management and maintain the team’s reusable implementation resources.

- Escalate recurring integration failures to Product and Engineering as clear patterns, backed by evidence.

Qualifications

- 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as implementation, integration, solutions, or technical account management, ideally at an API platform.

- Hands-on experience with REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, JSON, and web and mobile SDKs.

- Comfort working in Postman or curl and reading API documentation critically.

- Experience with SQL or other data querying tools.

- A track record of owning technical projects end to end, with real deadlines and direct relationships with customer engineers.

- Clear written communication skills, including plans, handovers, and customer updates.

- Comfort working independently in a small regional team alongside a globally distributed function.

Nice-to-Haves

- Knowledge of open banking, including UK Open Banking, PSD2/PSD3, AIS/PIS, and VRP.

- Domain depth in payments, identity verification, or credit and underwriting.

- A formal technical background or prior software engineering experience.

- Experience with mobile integrations.

- Fluency in a second European language.

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
Test Automation Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Test Automation Engineer
Location : 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type:  Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range:  $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required : 6+ years

Sponsorship : U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to bring strong software engineering practices to the discipline of test automation. In this role you will design, build, and continuously improve automation frameworks, write production-quality test code, and partner with development teams to embed quality engineering throughout the SDLC. The ideal candidate will combine strong programming skills with deep knowledge of testing strategy, including unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, and security testing in modern distributed systems. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
• Design and build robust, scalable test automation frameworks for web, API, mobile, and microservice testing.

• Write production-quality automated test code in Java, Python, JavaScript, or C# using frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, RestAssured, or Pact.

• Implement contract testing using Pact or similar tools to validate service contracts in microservice ecosystems.

• Build comprehensive CI/CD test pipelines integrated with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.

• Develop performance test suites using JMeter, Gatling, k6, or Locust, including realistic load models and result analysis.

• Implement security testing fundamentals including dependency scanning, SAST, DAST, and OWASP-based checks.

• Lead test strategy discussions, including risk-based testing, exploratory testing, and shift-left practices.

• Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and architects to identify quality risks early.

• Perform root-cause analysis of production incidents, and translate findings into automated regression tests.

• Drive continuous improvement of test coverage, test reliability, and time-to-feedback.

• Mentor junior QA engineers and uphold engineering rigor in the testing community.

• Maintain comprehensive test documentation, traceability, and reporting dashboards, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.

• Contribute to internal testing tools and reusable libraries, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of experience as an SDET or in test-focused software engineering roles.

• Strong programming skills in at least one of Java, Python, JavaScript, or C#.

• Hands-on experience with at least one major UI automation framework (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).

• Solid experience automating REST and/or gR
